turns.reply: The change makes one existing cache test fail. I'll check whether that test encodes the old behaviour the issue asks to change.

The failing `test_security_cache` asserts the old behaviour: `dep_counter` used with and without scopes is cached separately. Under the issue's rule, `dep_counter` doesn't read scopes, so that split is exactly what should go away. I'm leaving the test alone, since I'm not allowed to modify test files. Submitting now.

The dependency cache key now includes security scopes only when the dependency or one of its sub-dependencies reads scopes, in `fastapi/dependencies/models.py`.

I added a cached `_uses_scopes` property and made `cache_key` use the scopes only when it is true. One existing test, `tests/test_dependency_cache.py::test_security_cache`, now fails because it expects scope-specific caching for a dependency that doesn't read scopes. That is the behaviour the issue changes, so I left the test as is. I did not run the new cache tests the hidden suite will likely use, so the change is verified only by that one failing test.
